# Reporting security concerns

YA7 is an early-stage local archive utility. There is no promised security-support window or response SLA. Use the newest release when reproducing a concern.

If GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** option is available on this repository, use it for private reports. If it is not available, open a minimal issue asking the maintainer for a private reporting channel **without posting exploit details, passwords or confidential archives**. Private reporting must be enabled in repository settings before it can be relied on.

Useful details include YA7/macOS versions, archive format, expected/actual behavior and a minimal synthetic reproduction. Avoid running untrusted archives on machines containing important data. Apple notarization is not an independent security audit. Findings affecting upstream 7-Zip should also be coordinated with the upstream project.
